title: Move creation identity and editable titles behind the daemon
description: Implement user-confirmed daemon-owned creation fields and separate one-to-one editable title metadata while preserving immutable thought content and evolution ancestry. Quick capture accepts only text and optional title; daemon assigns id, creation timestamp, authenticated authorship, kind and origin and returns the saved record. Structured development commands may carry parent/source references without making callers generate storage identity or time. Move existing title values safely into separate metadata, preserve user/AI title attribution apart from note authorship, permit user edit/clear, and expose safe AI fill-only-when-absent for later weaver integration. Clearing permits regeneration with first-five-word fallback; late AI fills must not overwrite user titles. Reconcile API, domain commands, scripts/demo, tests and docs coherently, without a parallel legacy public creation path. Use simulated calls only: no real agent integration. Preserve existing data through isolated migration tests; never touch real user DB or user-modified setup script.
design: Two test-first slices. A: dedicated one-to-one title metadata/current author, legacy SQLite migration preserving existing titles/content/source seals/rejection/responses, ordinary scoped reads join metadata; user edit/clear vs atomic AI fill-if-absent on active note. No real agent call; keep immutable core protected. Prefer removing legacy title column after safe backfill using supported SQLite migration (or explicit reviewed robust migration), not two authoritative title sources. Internal full-value constructor can remain for controlled persistence/tests. B: business command service injects IDs/clock; POST /thoughts is user quick-capture text+optionaltitle only; distinguish user contributions and AI developments with parent-scoped semantic commands, not generic caller-classified captures. Connection identity also daemon-assigned consistently. Title user-edit and AI-fill commands distinct. Update scripts/demo/API fixtures/README from returnedIDs/times; remove old public caller-generated creation contract, no parallel legacypath. Tests use isolated old-schema migration/reopen, actual SQL conditional writes/race order and rejected exclusion, mock command deps, API strict body/auth, public demo/regressions. Unknown material migration issues escalate. Roles: fixer test-author then separate production role; independent tester; fresh oracle bun-typescript-reviewer for migration and terminal command/API review. Preserve user setupscript and never read local credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Daemon generates ID/time and returns created record; optional titles need no extra client fetch. Existing title values migrate without loss into separate metadata; note text, authorship, timestamps, source links and parent remain immutable. User can edit/clear title; safe AI fill cannot overwrite current user title, and clear permits a new fill. Thought authorship and title attribution remain distinct, rejected material excluded from AI title operations. Controlled unit tests plus SQL/API/script integration coverage verify behavior and preserve evolution/rejection rules.
